titolo: Why Did the US Get Rich While Latin America Fell Behind?
descrizione:
#History #EconomicHistory #WorldHistory

Why Did America Get So Rich While Latin America Stayed Poor?

Three hundred years ago, Latin America possessed enormous wealth, powerful cities, gold, and silver. Meanwhile, much of colonial North America was still struggling to survive. So how did the United States become an economic superpower while much of Latin America fell behind?

This history documentary explores the economic divide between the United States and Latin America, from Spanish colonization and the silver mines of Potosí to American industrialization and the rise of modern capitalism.

Discover how colonial institutions, land ownership, geography, political stability, and education helped shape two very different economic paths — and why natural resources alone could not guarantee prosperity.

trascrizione_inizio: If you traveled back in time 300 years and asked anyone which part of the Americas would become the richest, most powerful empire on the planet, almost nobody would have picked the United States. They would have pointed straight to Latin America. In the 17th century, cities like Mexico City, Havana, and Lima were bustling metropolises. They had universities, huge cathedrals, paved streets, and theaters, while Boston and New York were basically cold, muddy villages clinging to the edge of an empty forest. Latin America was sitting on literal mountains of silver and gold. Sugar and tobacco were printing money for the Spanish and Portuguese crowns. The north had practically nothing of value. No gold, no silver, bad weather, and rocks in the soil. So, how did the poor, boring, cold north completely flip the script and become the richest superpower in human history, while Latin America, blessed with endless wealth, got left behind? It seems like a mystery, but the answer comes down to a few big traps that history laid out. Traps that Latin America fell into and the United States managed to avoid. The first big reason sounds completely backwards, but it is true. Latin America was cursed by its own riches, and the United States was saved by having nothing. When the Spanish conquistadors arrived in Central and South America, they hit the jackpot. They conquered massive, organized empires like the Aztecs and the Incas. Even better for them, they found silver. In a place called Potosi in modern-day Bolivia, they found an entire mountain made almost entirely of silver.
